∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group.{u_1} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_1} G] {V : Type u_2} [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_3 : Module.{0, u_2} Complex V] [inst_4 : Module.Finite.{0, u_2} Complex V] [inst_5 : Module.{0, u_2} Real V]
  [IsScalarTower.{0, 0, u_2} Real Complex V] (ρ : Representation.{0, u_1, u_2} Complex G V),
  IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} (MonoidAlgebra.{0, u_1} Complex G) (Representation.asModule.{0, u_1, u_2} ρ) →
    Etingof.IsRealType.{u_1, u_2} ρ →
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun W =>
        And
          (∀ (g : G) (v : V),
            Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W v →
              Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W
                (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
                  v))
          (And (Eq.{u_2 + 1} (Submodule.span.{0, u_2} Complex (SetLike.coe.{u_2, u_2} W)) Top.top.{u_2})
            (Eq.{1} (Module.finrank.{0, u_2} Real (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W x))
              (Module.finrank.{0, u_2} Complex V)))
